newsitem.title: USA: Alrenco says Fastway to help '97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Alrenco says Fastway to help '97 earnings.

text.p: Alrenco Inc said Thursday it acquired Fastway Inc, a 28-store rental purchase operator based in Little Rock, Ark., a transaction it expects to be moderately accretive to 1997 earnings.

Separately, Alrenco, an operator of rental-purchase stores, said it completed the previously announced acquisition of four stores in Dallas and purchased an additional three stores in Alabama, one in Miami and one in Phoenix.

Chairman Michael Walts said the comapny would growth through acquisitions and by internal expansion, noting "We will be extremely selective in evaluating acquisitions and focus on the integration on the integration and improvement of the stores we own."
